screen.quantumflux.guide.help: Pause, replay or drag the timeline.
screen.quantumflux.guide.linking.step1: With a network selected, Sneak + Use the gadget on a pylon to start linking.
screen.quantumflux.guide.linking.step2: Use the gadget on a nearby machine that accepts E. The beam marks its link to the pylon.
screen.quantumflux.guide.linking.step3: Link more machines within range. Each machine keeps all its faces free for other connections.
screen.quantumflux.guide.linking.step4: Use the gadget in the air to finish linking. To remove a link, enter linking mode and use Sneak + Use on that machine.
screen.quantumflux.guide.linking.title: Linking
screen.quantumflux.guide.power.step1: Feed E into either pylon from a generator or energy storage. Pylons distribute energy; they do not generate it.
screen.quantumflux.guide.power.step2: Loaded pylons in the same network share available energy. They can feed machines even when the input is at another pylon.
screen.quantumflux.guide.power.step3: Energy flows only when a linked machine can accept it. The controller's E/t readout reflects energy actually delivered.
screen.quantumflux.guide.power.step4: Pylons and machines need loaded chunks. This mod does not keep distant areas loaded for you.
screen.quantumflux.guide.power.title: Power
screen.quantumflux.guide.setup.step1: Hold the Flux Gadget and use Sneak + Use to switch it on.
screen.quantumflux.guide.setup.step2: Use the active gadget in the air. Create a network, give it a name and select it.
screen.quantumflux.guide.setup.step3: Place a Flux Pylon with space above it. Use the active gadget on it to assign your selected network.
screen.quantumflux.guide.setup.step4: Connect an E source to the pylon. The pylon distributes energy; it does not generate any.
screen.quantumflux.guide.setup.title: Setup
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step1: No linked machines: assign a network and connect a machine with the gadget.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step2: Waiting for power: the network has no available E. Check its generators, cables and energy storage.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step3: Transferring: energy is reaching linked machines. Open the pylon page to see delivery to each one.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step4: Standby: energy is available, but no machine is accepting it. Check for full buffers, disabled inputs or unloaded machines.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step5: Paused by redstone: check the signal at either pylon half and its Redstone setting. Input and shared storage still work.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.step6: Network buffer: this pylon belongs to a network but has no machine links. Its energy is still available to the other loaded pylons.
screen.quantumflux.guide.status.title: Status
screen.quantumflux.guide.timeline.help: Click or drag to pause at a step. When focused, use Left / Right to move five seconds, or Home / End.
screen.quantumflux.guide.title: Flux Pylons Guide
screen.quantumflux.guide.upgrades.step1: Open a pylon with the gadget, then choose Upgrades. Range upgrades add four blocks per level, within the server limit.
screen.quantumflux.guide.upgrades.step2: Connection Capacity upgrades add two machine links per level. Install them in the Links slot.
screen.quantumflux.guide.upgrades.step3: Throughput upgrades add half the base output per level. Four levels give three times the base output.
screen.quantumflux.guide.upgrades.step4: Buffer upgrades double storage per level. Drain to base capacity before removing them. Each slot holds up to four upgrades.
screen.quantumflux.guide.upgrades.title: Upgrades
